outcome: persistent pelvic girdle pain (PGP) 12 years postpartum
cohort: A cohort of women who delivered in 2002 were followed up 12 years postpartum.
finding: Persistency and duration of pain symptoms, along with widespread pain, are strong predictors of persistent pelvic girdle pain 12 years postpartum, often leading to long-term sick leave and disability pension, with spontaneous recovery being unlikely for a subgroup.
